en-US.DESC_KL_CAPTURE: Press any key to add/remove it from the allowed list. Escape cancels.
en-US.DESC_KL_PROFILE_NAME: Rename the current profile, e.g. "12 Keys".
en-US.KL_SYNC_LOCKED: Keys are managed by the Key Viewer (Sync Keys to Key Limiter is on).
en-US.KL_CHART_NOTE: Adds a Key Limiter event to the level editor. A chart can cap how many distinct keys you may use from one tile onward and pick what an extra press does: ignore it, kill the run, or fire tagged events. Reopen the level after changing this.
en-US.DESC_CHARTKEYLIMITER_ENABLE: Lets levels carry a Key Limiter event and enforces it while you play.
